title: us_short_account_state_lineage
description: Provenance sidecar for us_short_account_state: which CSV each fact came from (sha256 + row_count), facts-vs-decision as-of separation, and how the US-short bucket capital was derived. This sidecar is NOT consumed by the engine/report; it exists for audit/reproducibility only. It carries real account figures, so it MUST be written to a gitignored private path (same fail-closed guard as the state file).

generated_at.description: Wall-clock stamp filled by main(); null in the pure build (kept out of deterministic core).

facts_as_of.description: account.csv as_of; must be <= decision_as_of (no future facts).

consistency_warnings.description: Advisory trades<->positions reconciliation warnings (populated by the trades slice; empty here). WARN-only, never overrides positions.
